name: Just Dying
storyline: The digital world has a dark flipside: The Algorithm Abyss. A demonic entity known as Shadow, sick of content creators making easy money, has kidnapped the very source of their power: their subscribers' souls. Faced with the threat of unemployment and total irrelevance, streamers are forced to enter this nightmare dimension to rescue them. While most enter reluctantly and with zero effort, one "tryhard" decides to take things to the extreme. After a critical error while trying to overclock his custom armor, he accidentally fuses with his own gaming setup. Thus, Shock-As is born: a heavy, rusty, and furious dieselpunk cyborg. Now turned into an overheating combat tank, he must smash his way through the Abyss to rescue his precious subs and prove he is the absolute TOP 1.
summary: A 2D action Roguelite where you play streamer parodies and die on purpose. Unlock characters, stack relics, snowball into a screen-clearing menace, then watch it all collapse in 30 seconds. Learn. Die again.
